newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB FIXES CROWN 4.22 PCT VS MARK/USD BASKET.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB FIXES CROWN 4.22 PCT VS MARK/USD BASKET.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.867 to the dollar after Friday's fixing at 27.771, and at 17.023 to the mark from 17.006.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +4.22 percent, after a deviation of +4.4 on Friday.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown was at the +4.27 on the interbank market.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
